newsitem.title: USA: Call-Net stake held by Universal Canadian.
newsitem.headline: Call-Net stake held by Universal Canadian.

text.p: Universal Canadian Growth Fund Ltd said Friday it holds a 5.2 percent stake in Call-Net Enterprises Inc, or 1,106,485 common shares.
In a filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, Universal said its latest transactions included the purchase of 50,000 shares on November 7 at C$14.60 per share.
Universal said the stake is held for investment purposes. It said the Call-Net shares are held for it by Mackenzie Financial Corp, its investment adviser.
Toronto-based Call-Net consists of a group of Canadian companies providing personal and business communications services throughout Canada.
